title: Microsoft Forms: Copilot in Forms for US Government clouds
summary: Hold: the briefing treats licensing as unpublished, although Microsoft's Forms FAQ requires a valid Microsoft Copilot licence. It also overlooks the documented AI Administrator role and understates the potential licensing cost. The roadmap facts match, and no separate Forms Copilot switch or government-cloud arrival default was found.
